items.source: Return the integer associated with the given key.
items.translation: 返回与给定键关联的整数。

items.source:
Helper method to create a StringSwitcher.
For finer control over the generated instance, use a new instance of StringSwitcher.Generator
instead of this static method.
items.translation: 用于创建 StringSwitcher 的辅助方法。如需对生成的实例进行更精细的控制，请使用 StringSwitcher.Generator 的新实例代替此静态方法。

items.source: fixedInput - if false, an unknown key will be returned from intValue(String) as -1; if true, the result will be undefined, and the resulting code will be faster
items.translation: fixedInput - 如果为 false，则从intValue(String)返回未知键作为 -1；如果为 true，结果将未定义，且生成的代码速度更快。

items.source: the associated integer value, or -1 if the key is unknown (unless fixedInput was specified when this StringSwitcher was created, in which case the return value for an unknown key is undefined)
items.translation: 关联的整数值，或者如果键未知则返回 `-1`（除非在创建此 `StringSwitcher` 时指定了 `fixedInput，在这种情况下，未知键的返回值未定义）。

items.source: This class implements a simple String → int mapping for a fixed set of keys.
items.translation: 该类为固定的一组键实现了一个简单的 String → int 映射。

items.source: Helper method to create a StringSwitcher.
items.translation: 用于创建 StringSwitcher 的辅助方法。

items.source: strings - the array of String keys; must be the same length as the value array
items.translation: strings - 字符串键数组；必须与值数组长度相同

items.source: ints - the array of integer results; must be the same length as the key array
items.translation: ints - 整数结果数组；必须与键数组长度相同
